knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.subtitle: Collections of documents your assistants answer from. Upload files or connect a website, bucket or repository; changes are picked up automatically.
knowledge.newCollectionBody: A collection groups related content with one model, one sensitivity level and one set of access rules.
knowledge.emptyBody: Start with product docs or a help center. You can upload files or point Nexiqon at a website.
knowledge.nameRule: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes (2–63 characters).
knowledge.nameTaken: A collection with this name already exists.
knowledge.accessGroupsHelp: Only members of these groups can retrieve this content. Leave empty for everyone in the workspace.
knowledge.documentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}
knowledge.notFound: This collection does not exist or you cannot see it.
knowledge.reindexHint: Reprocess every document (after changing chunking or the embedding model)
knowledge.settingsBody: Changing the model, retrieval profile, sensitivity or access groups reindexes the collection.
knowledge.reindexWarningBody: Every document is processed again. While that runs, documents not yet reprocessed are briefly missing from answers.
knowledge.deleteCollectionHint: Delete the collection, its index and stored files
knowledge.deleteCollectionBody: This removes {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} and {sources, plural, =0 {no connected sources} one {# connected source} other {# connected sources}}, the search index and every stored file. Assistants stop answering from it immediately. This cannot be undone.
knowledge.processingLive: Processing… this list updates by itself.
knowledge.replaceHint: Upload a new version of this file
knowledge.deleteHint: Remove from search and delete the stored file
knowledge.deleteDocumentBody: Its {chunks, plural, one {# chunk is} other {# chunks are}} removed from search before this finishes, and the stored file is deleted.

errorHints.unsupported_type: This file type cannot be read yet. Upload PDF, Word, Markdown, HTML, text, CSV or JSON.
errorHints.parse_failed: The file could not be read. Check that it opens normally and is not password protected.
errorHints.empty_document: No text was found. Scanned images need text recognition (OCR) before upload.
errorHints.malware_detected: The virus scan flagged this file, so it was quarantined and never read.
errorHints.scan_unavailable: The virus scanner was unavailable. Try again shortly; nothing unscanned is processed.
errorHints.fetch_blocked: This address is not allowed (private or internal networks are blocked).
errorHints.fetch_failed: The source could not be reached. Check the address and try syncing again.
errorHints.too_large: The file is larger than the allowed size.
errorHints.credentials_missing: The credentials this source needs are not set up. Ask an administrator.
errorHints.embedding_failed: The model refused this content, often because of its sensitivity. Choose a model profile allowed for it.
errorHints.embedding_model_changed: The model profile changed. Reindex the collection to use the new model.
errorHints.profile_unavailable: The retrieval profile could not be loaded. Check it in Configuration.
errorHints.temporarily_unavailable: The model service did not respond. Check the model provider settings, then reindex.

abstainReasons.low_evidence: The best passages were not close enough to the question, so no answer was generated.
abstainReasons.no_passages: Nothing in the selected collections matches this question.
abstainReasons.unsupported: The model's answer was not supported by the sources, so it is not shown as an answer.
abstainReasons.sensitivity: The selected model profile may not receive content this sensitive, so no answer was generated.

playground.removedCitations: {count, plural, one {# citation was} other {# citations were}} removed: {reasons}.

release.nothingToCompare: Nothing to compare yet: this is the first version.

graph.label: Workflow with {count} steps
graph.scrollLabel: Workflow diagram (scroll sideways to see all steps)

inspector.title: Answer Inspector
inspector.subtitle: Why this answer happened: what was understood, found, used and checked.
inspector.unavailable: This run's trace is not available.
inspector.tokens: {input} in · {output} out · {calls, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}}

why.blocked: The question touched a blocked topic ({topic}), so it got a fixed reply and no model saw it.
why.askedForPerson: The user asked for a person.
why.routedByModel: The model read the question as “{intent}” and took the {route} path.
why.routedByExamples: The question matched the examples of “{intent}”, so it took the {route} path without a model call.
why.routedFallback: The intent was unclear, so the assistant took the {route} path.
why.injection: Parts of the question looked like instructions to the assistant; they were treated as text.
why.foundSources: {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} found; evidence strength {evidence}%.
why.weakEvidence: The evidence was below this assistant's minimum, so it did not answer from it.
why.toolOk: The tool {tool} returned data that the answer could use.
why.toolFailed: The tool {tool} did not return data ({error}).
why.neutralised: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} in the sources looked like instructions and were removed before the model saw them.
why.withheld: The answer repeated the assistant's instructions, so it was withheld.
why.guarded: {count, plural, one {# item was} other {# items were}} removed from the answer (images, unknown links or HTML).
why.citationsRemoved: {count, plural, one {# citation was} other {# citations were}} removed because the sources did not support them.
why.waiting: The assistant is waiting for the user ({kind}).
why.abstained: No claim could be backed by a source, so the assistant said it could not answer.
why.grounded: The answer is backed by {count, plural, one {# verified citation} other {# verified citations}}.

inspector.sources: {count, plural, one {# source considered} other {# sources considered}}
inspector.aclNote: Only sources this user may see are searched. To check what someone else can see, use Access preview.
